admission_rule: Admission requires a pinned version and digest, the theorem class it is entitled to establish, its TCB, a positive and a negative control, and the rustc range it actually supports. A tool that was not tested is refused, not admitted by default. No tool is admitted in this record.

pinned_toolchain.rule: A tool that cannot process the pinned compiler is not admitted, and this is not a reason to change the pinned compiler without a separate decision.

tools.name: Kani

negative_control.observed: exit 1, VERIFICATION:- FAILED, Status: FAILURE at the assertion

positive_control.observed: exit 0, VERIFICATION:- SUCCESSFUL, 1 successfully verified harness

tools.refusal_reason: It does not support the pinned rustc 1.98.1: it runs on its bundled nightly-2026-08-21 (rustc 1.100.0-nightly), so a Kani result describes a different compilation unit from the pinned candidate. The programme forbids citing it for the binary.
tcb: the harness and its declared bounds
tools.theorem_class: bounded model checking of a Rust harness under declared unwind and size bounds; a SUCCESSFUL result is a theorem about that harness and those bounds, not a universal statement

verification.settling_method: Re-run the recorded positive and negative controls in the court if a Kani release supports the pinned toolchain; until then it is admitted for nothing.

tools.name: z3
tools.purpose: cryptographic specification and symbolic equivalence (SMT backend)
tools.refusal_reason: It has no Rust front-end and no verified encoding of the crate's semantics was built, so it can establish nothing about the crate by itself. ETP-4 admitted it for nothing.
tcb: the encoding, which does not exist
tools.theorem_class: SMT decision procedure over an externally supplied encoding; it has no Rust semantics of its own

verification.settling_method: Add a separately verified encoding of the property and re-run; the solver alone remains unadmitted for Rust claims.
